When you wear them, you're not just changing your appearance; you're often stepping into a mindset that matches those associations. It can create a kind of psychological armor or a signal to yourself that "it's time to be my most capable self."

If it works for you, that's a great tool to have. Confidence that comes from something as simple as clothing is still real confidence. The key is that *you* feel it—how you feel in your clothes matters more than any fashion rule.
